title: gymnolomia guatemalensis
intro: Gymnolomia guatemalensis, commonly known as Guatemalan rosewood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The health benefits of Gymnolomia guatemalensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, infections, and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and provide a range of health benefits when used in traditional medicine.
